properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_limit_each_part_meets_on_its_own.rs. Pins: the barn's 12 ft breaks the 100 ft well clearance and is named; two 6 ft parts never make a 10 ft setback; all parts clear reads within on the nearest; an unstated part leaves it open unless a stated one already breaks it; an empty `each` limit reads incomplete; a maximum reads the tallest part; a KPP judged on each is breached by its worst part; DEPENDS_ON among parts changes nothing; a summed minimum nothing has measured reads incomplete, not exceeded.
properties.findings: Observed failing first on 66a8ea279 (commit 930a6c489 adds the tests alone): all 10 failed, 9 refused at set_constraint_composition("each") and the summed-minimum one read exceeded. After 05ac6178f all pass, inside a full reflow2-core run (2,085 + 231 + 4) and again after merging main 9cb658c4b; clippy -D warnings clean.
properties.name: A limit each part meets on its own is judged on its worst part (10 tests)
